script.source_monologue: Nobody tells you self respect isn't free at first I shut this door and my hand kept shaking It cost more than I had, that first time Later I closed it and my breath stayed even So the door didn't get lighter, I got steadier I used to think refusing them would feel like winning It felt like nothing, just a door, closed Now it stays shut without me guarding it I live here, door closed, and still breathe easy
